## Checks

- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy`, and `cargo test --workspace` pass
- [ ] `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, and `pnpm test` pass
- [ ] A conformance case covers any behavior change
- [ ] What the change touches is ticked off in [the change checklists](https://github.com/ascribed-dev/ascribe/blob/main/project-docs/checklists.md), and any decision it makes is in [decisions.md](https://github.com/ascribed-dev/ascribe/blob/main/project-docs/decisions.md)
